messages:
toni: Quick thread  Enterprise customer (MegaBank) asking to pin a bespoke quantized variant for a 30-day pilot. They need guaranteed artifact + rollback SLA.

raghu: Are they asking to pin in our public catalog or only on their dedicated fleet?

emily: They want pin on Dedicated (for data isolation) and also tracker in catalog so SREs recognize the artifact.

hugo: Ops concerns: quantized builds can behave differently across GPU families. Need an automated deterministic-snapshot step + tokenization hash check. Also need a hot-rollback plan that preserves the tokenizer version.

ton i: Proposal: introduce a "pin-exemption" flow for large-enterprise pilots: 1) snapshot (weights+tokenizer) + digest, 2) golden-output capture for 200 prompts, 3) 7-day smoke on dedicated infra, 4) 30-day TTL pin with mandatory legal waiver and rollback SLA.

emily: Sales/CS will push for permanent pin if pilot goes well. We should gate that with stability metrics (median quality within 1pt of baseline and seed variance <2.5%).

raghu: Development notes: building snapshot tooling is ~3 biz days. Golden-output capture and automation ~2 days. Rollback automation to meet 1h unpin SLA ~4 days.

audits-bot: audit: pin-exemption:required=true, ttl_supported=true, artifact_digest_required=true

hugo: Also recommend we require a customer-signed pin-waiver that clarifies behavioral delta risk and fallback model mismatch.

ton i: Drafting a short-runbook now. Question for product: do we allow customers to opt-into pinning that bypasses our model-change alerts?

emily: No. Pin should subscribe to change alerts; legal waiver doesn't remove our right to notify. But alerts can be sent to a dedicated contact.

raghu: Decision points: (A) offer pin-exemption pilot under the 4-step flow above, (B) block pining until snapshot+rollback tooling shipped. My recommendation: ship flow and require all pre-reqs before enabling pin for MegaBank.

ton i: Agreed. Action items: raghu->start snapshot tool (3d), hugo->design rollback SLA (4d), emily->prep legal waiver + sales comms, toni->write catalog note template.

emily: I'll coordinate MegaBank expectations. Can we commit to a start window next Monday?

ton i: If tooling starts today, yes. We'll update customer and reopen thread after initial snapshot is complete. :white_check_mark:
